description: 编码主界面 (Medical Coding page) — Phase 2 cycle 19 first UI target. Two Corti parity gaps: 字符计数 (real-time char/cost counter in input area header) and 分段高亮 (click code row → highlight evidence span in input panel).

checks.description: Input area header shows a live char + cost estimate that updates on every keystroke (not just after Predict).
Plain <textarea> in MedicalCodingPage is replaced by HighlightedTextarea component (proves the input panel was migrated to the overlay pattern).

HighlightedTextarea component renders BOTH a textarea (input) AND a <pre> overlay (highlight display), shares INPUT_TEXT_CLASS for font-metric sync, and uses EvidenceHighlighter as JSX (not just imported).

EvidenceHighlighter accepts a focusedSpanIndex prop and renders a distinct class (bg-green) for the focused span vs default (bg-yellow) for others — matches Corti screenshot where clicked code's evidence shows in green.
Two new i18n keys (charCount, costEstimate) added to BOTH zh-CN and en-US locale objects in locales.ts. Parity test enforces this automatically.
Runtime (Playwright): typing in the input updates [data-testid=char-counter] text per keystroke (not gated on Predict).

Code table row carries data-testid='code-row-{i}' AND the row's onClick calls setFocusedSpanIndex so the focused state flows down to EvidenceHighlighter (bg-green). Static-only because the runtime path is blocked by an env-level bug: the page references v1.0.0 of the agent, but the registry only has v2.0.0 (the runtime runner hits 404). Re-enable runtime after the agent ref mismatch is fixed.

runtime._deferred: agent ref mismatch — page uses 'medical-coding-agent-1.0.0' but registry only has 'icoder/medical-coding-agent@2.0.0'. Fix the ref in MedicalCodingPage.tsx before re-enabling this runtime check.
runtime.test_name: click code row highlights evidence in green

steps.value: Patient has chronic heart failure, NYHA class III.
